title: Media viewer
summary: Full screen for a photo or video of a chat: zoom, play, swipe to the next or previous media of the same chat, and share, save, reply or delete from a bar.

senderName.description: Shown in the top bar with the time.

isLoadingFull.description: true while the full-size file downloads; the thumbnail shows meanwhile.

chromeHidden.description: true after a tap hides the bars.

swipe.effect: Shows the next or previous image or video of the loaded timeline. At the oldest loaded one, back-paginates.

share.effect: Downloads the full file to the cache and opens the system share sheet.

save.effect: Saves the photo or video to the phone gallery. Asks the gallery permission the first time; shows bipe_app_media_saved.

reply.effect: Closes the viewer and runs message-reply startReply for this media.

delete.effect: Runs message-delete askDelete; after a delete the viewer closes.

close.effect: Swipe down or the close button: back to the chat at this media.

notes: The decrypted file stays in the app cache. Saving or sharing is the only way it leaves the app, and only when the person asks.
Video plays inline in the viewer with the system player controls; sound on.
bipe_app_media_gallery_permission shows when the gallery permission is denied, with a link to the system settings.
A save or share failure shows bipe_app_media_save_failed.
Captions show at the bottom over the media; long captions scroll.
Forward is not in this spec; it needs the forward picker (ADR 0053: the self-chat is the first target) of the composer issue.
The reply and delete buttons use the message-actions labels (bipe_app_message_action_reply, bipe_app_message_action_delete, bipe-chat/bipe#559).
